notes.zh: 回答与 H100 同功耗档、显存翻到 141GB 的卡是什么水平，用于判断「模型能不能整卡放下」。注意官方在该页标注规格为初步数据、可能变动，采购前须回到最新 datasheet 复核。不回答实际推理吞吐：页面上的加速倍数来自厂商特定 batch 与序列长度条件。
notes.en: Answers what a card at the same power tier as H100 but with 141 GB of memory represents, which is what a "does the model fit on one card" decision needs. The vendor marks these figures as preliminary and subject to change on this page, so the current datasheet must be re-checked before procurement. It does not answer measured inference throughput: the speed-up multiples on the page come from specific vendor batch sizes and sequence lengths.

specs.MIG: up to 7 instances at 18 GB each
